Perfect! Black wins the rook cleanly. The main line is: **Ra2** (attacking the rook), **Rg7+** (White's best try), **Kxg7** (Black captures the rook and is up material decisively).

**Coaching Note:**

When your opponent has advanced a pawn far from defense, don't rush to attack it directly. Look for your active pieces—here, your rook can move to a quiet square that attacks an undefended attacker. If White checks to create counterplay, you simply capture. Always scan for undefended pieces your opponent created while pushing forward. This quiet move wins material decisively.
